title: Matte Black 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar - Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection (Traditional), Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Matte Black, stop dealing with flimsy towel bars and mismatched finishes—this 30-inch wall mount towel bar delivers enduring, coordinated style, backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs.

  • Matte Black makes a bold, modern statement
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Holds up to daily use with solid brass construction that outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives
  • Makes it easy to match your decor with a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes
  • Designed to coordinate with matching Carolina collection pieces for a unified bathroom

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Carolina collection for classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware that looks intentional from every angle.

Specs

  • Product type: Towel bar (straight bar)
  • Size: 30 Inch
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: 30-inch wall mount towel bar in solid brass with concealed mounting and 10 lb capacity. Traditional Carolina collection styling, Limited Lifetime Warranty.
